summary: Refactored PiAgentService into cohesive extracted modules (event hub, session catalog, session operations, runtime pool, session factory, model runtime, tool policy, shared types) while preserving pi-agent-service.ts as a stable facade. Reformatted an arrow-body unsubscribe for readability, replaced a wildcard type re-export with explicit named exports, ran prettier, type-check, and the full vitest suite (21 files, 114 tests passing), and confirmed each handwritten session file is <=300 LOC.
decisions: Kept apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts as the stable public facade/import path, with extracted types explicitly re-exported by name instead of via `export type *`.
